dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides many expert‑level nuances not commonly known to a baseline model: auto‑protection of CloudFront/Route 53, exact DRT role vs log‑bucket distinction, per‑protection health‑check requirement, pagination limits, ARN‑only matching, trust‑policy principal nuance, stale‑protection handling, EIP allocation ID format, cost‑protection credit gating, subscription auto‑renewal terms, and Application Layer Automatic Response prerequisites. The only minor omission is a deeper explanation of cost‑protection eligibility criteria.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Provides an AWS‑specific, ordered procedure (subscription gate → coverage → DRT → health‑check → proactive engagement → WAF → automatic response) with concrete CLI commands, pagination loop, ARN matching rule, and trust‑policy verification. No generic placeholders.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a thorough NEVER list with precise reasoning for each pitfall (e.g., never flag CloudFront as UNPROTECTED, never treat CONFIG_GAP as worse than NO_DRT_ACCESS, never assume deleted IAM role is still usable, etc.). Each anti‑pattern is explained with the operational impact.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Complete front‑matter (name, description, version, author, license, compatibility, keywords, tags, metadata) and a clear when‑to‑use section, activation triggers, and an explicit invocation schema. The description unambiguously defines WHAT the skill does, WHEN to invoke, and KEYWORDS for activation.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Layers information effectively: a one‑line Mindset, a 7‑step Quick‑Start, a concise verdict table, then detailed step‑by‑step logic, deep reference, edge‑case handling, anti‑patterns, safety gates, and remediation. The only slight overload is the very long “Deep reference” section, which could be tucked further down.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions (CreateSubscription, DeleteProtection, AssociateDRTRole) are gated by explicit confirmation prompts and financial‑commitment warnings. Creative tasks (audit classification) are left unconstrained, matching task fragility appropriately.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable pattern: Mindset, Quick‑start, Step‑by‑step process, Output format, Edge‑case handling, Anti‑patterns, Deep reference. The structure is consistent with other AWS CloudOps skills.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: The decision tree, pagination loop, exact CLI commands, and output format enable an agent to execute the audit end‑to‑end. The only shortfall is that the output schema does not explicitly define how to represent multi‑region aggregation (the skill mentions per‑region findings but the sample output shows a single SCOPE), which could cause ambiguity for agents handling accounts spanning many regions.
